subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` as a public config key, and should changes to it hot-apply to future queue entries or require a gateway restart?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the fix adds public configuration surface in a compatibility-sensitive diagnostics path, so automation should not choose the permanent key and reload contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, generated config docs, tests, and reload planning agree that future queue entries use the refreshed threshold.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Keep a configurable threshold but document and test restart-required semantics instead of promising config-reload behavior.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Leave the threshold fixed or solve log noise through a broader diagnostics policy, then close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, generated config docs, tests, and reload planning agree that future queue entries use the refreshed threshold.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest queue feature-history signal and already provided item-specific guidance for this config/docs/test decision.
